activities.title: Match the person with their hobby.
Listen to the secret hobbies report. Write a word or number in each gap.

data.script: Diego: Secret hobbies, episode one! First: our maths teacher collects tiny spoons. He has got ninety-two! … Oliver: Ninety-two spoons! Where does he keep them? … Diego: On three shelves in his kitchen. Next: the school cook loves photography. … Diego: She takes photos of clouds every morning before work. … Oliver: Beautiful! And what about you, Diego? … Diego: Me? I collect old radios. My grandpa gave me the first one. … Oliver: And my secret hobby is… cooking! I make excellent banana pancakes. … Diego: Tomorrow: does the head teacher really dance tango? Don't miss it!

data.script: Look at the picture. Listen and write the names. There is one example. … Diego: Who is that in the school garden? The boy in the red shirt with a microphone. … Maya: That is Diego. Diego is asking questions with his microphone. … Diego: And who is the boy with red hair and a yellow shirt? … Maya: That is Oliver. Look, Oliver is singing. … Diego: And who is the big black bird with a white collar? … Maya: That is Kili. Look, Kili is carrying a letter. … Diego: And who is the boy with curly brown hair and a green shirt? … Maya: That is Bruno. Look, Bruno is running after the ball. … Diego: And who is the girl with long straight black hair and an orange shirt? … Maya: That is Aiko. Look, Aiko is reading a book.
